events.title: Beaujolais Day
events.description:
Reindeer & friends invite you to join us for A Very British Beaujolais Day - a long lunch bringing everyone together for an Anglo-French feast, Beaujolais, live music, entertainment & great company.

In support of Maggie’s at City Hospital, with every ticket helping to support people with cancer and their families.

events.title: Omakase Tasting Experience
events.description:
Join us at The Reindeer on Wednesday 2 December at 7pm for an Omakase Tasting Experience with SHIO.

Expect a set tasting menu of Japanese dishes served course by course, from sashimi and nigiri to SHIO’s special maki roll, with a miso custard tart to finish.

£80 per person, with an optional drinks pairing for £35.

Limited spaces available. Get booked in.
